debussy.sourceScore: DCMLab/debussy_images l110-01_images_reflets (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), corrected to 94 original bars using WJEC guidance
debussy.algorithm: librosa chroma_cqt 12-bin + global cosine DTW; no hand-audited anchors
caveats: DTW does not itself certify the correspondence at individual bars.
Different performances and Mozart repeat choices change all timestamps.
Piano rubato and sustain can shift apparent chord onsets.
Written-score fraction is not elapsed-time fraction.
Bar counts follow the DCMLab transcription, not the previous UI guess.
